summary: Strive, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to announce periodic bitcoin purchases totaling 381.61 BTC at an average price of ~$79,348 per bitcoin. The filing does not involve a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or any special-situation event; it simply updates the company's bitcoin treasury holdings and outstanding share counts. The forward-looking statement references a prior merger with Semler Scientific but does not trigger a new deal event. This is a routine operational disclosure for a company that holds bitcoin on its balance sheet, akin to microstrategy-style treasury updates. No material special-situation classification applies.
